Class TemporalEdgeList

java.lang.Object

edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.TemporalEdgeList
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<TemporalEdge>, RandomAccess
public class TemporalEdgeList extends EdgeList<TemporalEdge>
The list of temporal edges in a story graph, which represent how actions can change the state of a story from one node to another.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • add

      public TemporalEdge add(Node before, Action action, Node after)
      Creates a new temporal edge that extends from a tail node to a head node and is labeled with an action.

      If a temporal edge already exists from the tail node for this action and a different head node is given, this method throws an exception. If the same head node is given, the existing edge is returned.

      This method updates the story graph's meta-data last modified timestamp.

      Parameters:
      before - the tail node, representing the story state before the action
      action - the action that can be taken
      after - the head node, representing the story state after the action is taken
      Returns:
      a new temporal edge with the given tail, label, and head, or the existing edge if that exact edge already exists
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an edge already exists from the tail node for this action but not to the given head node
      IllegalArgumentException - if the tail node, action, or head node have been removed or were not created in this list's story graph
